reviews.text: A very competent clinic, incredible professionals, especially Dr. Gabriel Silveira Nunes, the best veterinarian I've ever met. He's an attentive and dedicated professional who cares for our pets and us, their owners, with affection and attention! My cats and I feel cared for and welcomed by him.

Aventura is always very well cared for. Dr. Gabriel has been taking care of him for years with great affection and attention. They are super specialists in felines and are always available whenever we need them. Thank you always! 🩵 …
They want to push various unnecessary tests and medications, which are entirely commercial.
It's an example of humanity. Of quality. All sectors are great. Great doctors. Mylla
My cat wouldn't be alive if it weren't for Valdo. I highly recommend him.
Dr. Valdo is the best veterinarian and feline specialist.
Amazing professionals!

I would like to express my deepest gratitude to the clinic and Dr. Gabriel for the care, affection, and attention they showed us and our cat Lilith. She was completely cured of hyperthyroidism through treatment with radioactive iodine. The treatment is super simple, does not cause pain or discomfort to the cats, and is the gold standard for treating this disease.
If your cat is also suffering from hyperthyroidism, don't think twice. I have no words to describe my gratitude knowing that she is COMPLETELY CURED after the treatment.
Thank you so much!

I had an excellent experience. Dr. Valdo is incredible, exactly as all his clients I know describe him. He knows what he's doing. He examines and makes a diagnosis without ordering two hundred unnecessary tests. I recommend him without hesitation and I am grateful for the care provided to my cat.

My cat Chantily, who is almost 14 years old, received excellent care! She had all the necessary support! The staff promptly answered questions... The clinic is wonderful! My princess is 100% cured! Thank you to the team for giving my cat years of life!!! So happy!!!

Dr. Gabriel Silveira, a feline specialist who treated our son Jão, was great at explaining iodine therapy. We really liked his service; this doctor is very caring with animals. And he made us feel very safe regarding the procedures. The environment is very good, and the reception staff is also excellent. There's also Jorge the kitten who roams around the clinic and is adorable.
Dr. Valdo, a reference in feline care, also guided us and answered all our questions via email.

My Spitz, Sushi, had cataracts and, on the recommendation of a veterinarian, I went to Dr. Angélica. In March 2021, surgery was performed on both eyes and everything went well. Since then, both Dr. Angélica and Dr. Anne have been our "safe haven" when it comes to veterinary ophthalmology! I trust them completely, recommend them, and admire their care, attention, kindness, experience, and quality! Thank you for providing excellent service to our loyal companions!
Excellent clinic, veterinarians specialized in cats and extremely humane. I trust them completely.
...sensitive service...
Excellent service
The consultation fee is outrageous.
Very good place, my cat received excellent care. The doctors and staff were very attentive.
Thank you very much for your feedback.
Veterinarians specializing in Ophthalmology. Dr. Angélica is a renowned expert!

I had a very frustrating experience with my dog ​​at Vetmasters. I went to the clinic because of a referral for cataract surgery. I first had the requested exam (electroretinography), and I was very satisfied with the anesthesiologist, who was attentive and explained everything to me. The problem came later. Dr. Angélica's team made me feel completely uncomfortable. I have a reactive dog, weighing only 10kg, who barks a lot in stressful situations. At no point did I stop worrying about this, holding him in my lap and calming him down so he wouldn't bother the other patients. However, the veterinarians who attended to me were completely unfriendly, they seemed disgusted, they barely looked at me. When Dr. Angélica finally came to see my dog, she practically didn't examine him either, standing in a corner saying that I should redo the exams. In short, the only one who showed empathy and patience with my dog ​​was the nurse, whose name I regret not knowing, but I thank her from the bottom of my heart. On top of everything, they had told me that I would only pay for the follow-up appointment, since I had already had a previous consultation within the deadline, but they charged me for a full consultation (just to look at my dog ​​from afar, with a disdainful expression). I left there crying.
I ended up having my dog's surgery at another clinic where I was treated very well, with patient and empathetic professionals who cared for an animal that doesn't understand what's happening and only feels fear. It's a shame that in some cases, experience and studies don't guarantee a good professional.
Terrible. The receptionist is completely out of touch with the reality of São Paulo and its chaotic traffic. Any delay, and they refuse to treat your pet without a shred of empathy.
Excellent experience, the veterinarians' service is superb, and the clinic is very beautiful and peaceful, which greatly helps with the cat's stress! I really like Vet Master!
Best place for cat care 🐱 …

I was there today for my elderly cat, Lincoln, to see Dr. Gabriel, a lovely veterinarian, and his nurse, Luiza, who is very polite, treated me very well. I left there very happy with the advice from the doctor and Luiza.

Simply the best place. My cat had been given up on by his previous vet, so I decided to take him to Vetmasters where we met Dr. Fernando Bento, who saved my son, and he's been doing great ever since. It wasn't anything like what the previous vet said; Dr. Fernando was spot-on with the diagnosis and treatment, and we started seeing my kitten get healthy again in just a few weeks. Since then, I always take my three cats to him. I also have a friend whose cat was saved by Dr. Valdo. The best clinic and the best professionals. I must emphasize that everyone is very friendly, attentive, and helpful in explaining things.

A very good place for pet care. I've been going to the feline section for 5 years with my cats and I'm very grateful. The team of professionals is incredible. For anyone looking for a great cat vet, I recommend Gabriel!

Excellent veterinary clinic with an extremely well-prepared and up-to-date medical staff. Very attentive professionals, confident in their procedures and truly caring for their patients. The affection shown to the felines and the dedication to complex cases make all the difference. Humane, punctual, ethical and top-quality service. I highly recommend a visit!
What I witnessed today was a total lack of organization and disrespect for clients at the clinic. I used to take my cat there, but I'm definitely not going back.

Terrible customer service and treatment.

Without a doubt, this was the worst clinic I've ever been to. The reception service is extremely inadequate: the client is treated with irony and disdain, demonstrating a total lack of professionalism.

The veterinarians use technical terms and adopt an arrogant posture, but in practice, they don't demonstrate mastery of the case and don't reach any clear or conclusive conclusions.

A warning: a high price is not synonymous with quality in the care or services provided.

RESPONSE: The response provided is inadequate and incompatible with professional service. Nothing justifies the arrogant attitude and lack of respect shown, conduct that only reinforces the image of a mediocre service far from the standard that the clinic claims to offer.
The professionals are very competent, dedicated, and friendly. I feel safe taking my cats there for checkups.
Great clinic with excellent professionals!

My cats, Simon and Bella, have been going to the clinic for over 10 years. They are very well cared for by excellent professionals (Dr. Valdo, Dr. Gabriel, Dr. Mariana, Dr. Michele, and others...). The place is very comfortable, and the reception area is separate from the dog care area, which is very important to us. I also really like the service; the receptionists are pleasant and attentive. There's also a vending machine for purchasing medications, which is a great help.
For all these reasons, I feel calm and at peace knowing that my beloved pets are in good hands. Thank you very much.

Hi!!! Comfortable and clean place, good service at reception, I liked the coffee area and most importantly was the consultation with Dr. Barbara, very attentive, informative and much more.
Thank you.

My dog ​​went blind during a neutering procedure when he was 1 year old. That's when I first encountered Vetmaster. At the time, he underwent all the necessary exams, but he completely lost his vision. Now, at 7 and a half years old, I had to bring him back because of an eye ulcer. He needed surgery, but given his condition and previous complications, we opted against it. He underwent a procedure under sedation, and everything went perfectly. I am so grateful to the doctors who treated him, Dr. Angelica, Dr. Barbara, and all the others who cared for him (I don't remember their names right now) – they were wonderful. I have previously recommended them to acquaintances and continue to do so because I know their dedication and professionalism.
Excellent clinic, perfect service from scheduling to the end of the consultation and completion of the exams, qualified and confident professionals in their analyses and feedback to the pet owner.
Cat experts

I decided to bring my pigeon in for a routine check-up, but apparently VetMasters wasn't prepared for a pigeon the size of a large microwave. As soon as I walked in, the automatic door locked because the bird occupied 80% of the sensor. The entire reception area fell silent… until it let out an echoing “growl.”

The veterinarian came in smiling, super confident, but the moment he put his hand on the pigeon's back, the smile vanished. The doctor stood motionless for about 3 seconds, as if trying to calculate the bird's body mass, and then simply whispered:
“Is this… normal?”

My pigeon turned its head 180° like a movie character, and the doctor RAN down the hall yelling, “CALL THE ZOO, THIS ISN'T A BIRD!!!”

The pigeon was offended, took three indignant steps, climbed onto the table, and almost broke it. The receptionist started praying, a dog that was waiting for an appointment barked as if narrating the scene, and a cat ran up onto the cabinet.

In the end, no one managed to examine my pigeon, but he got an oat biscuit the size of a brick and was happy.

Experience 10/10, I'll be back when he's a little bigger.
Dr. Valdo is an incredible professional, extremely competent! He has a top-notch team.

What I can say about the professionals at Vetmasters is their competence, attention, and welcoming attitude, which we pet owners and our four-legged angels so desperately need. I want to emphasize that among all the veterinarians on the team, one in particular deserves my praise: Dr. Gabriel Silveira. His human touch and his passion for his profession are qualities that bring us security and peace of mind during those difficult and frightening times we go through with our little ones. His clarification of doubts and detailed explanations of the illness are what lead us to persevere and find a positive and effective solution. Thank you for everything. 🙏❤️

Best doctor ever! Dr. Arquiovaldo! I have a Neva Masquerade cat who had chylothorax and was hospitalized at Veros Hospital and others. I spent a fortune! But Dr. Arquiovaldo from the Vetmasters clinic saved my cat. If I had gone to him first, I would have saved a lot of money because in desperation, clinics and hospitals take everything we have unnecessarily! Vetmasters clinic gets a thousand stars! I recommend them without hesitation.

I am very grateful to the Vetmasters team!
Dr. Gabriel is wonderful, his attention and care for our Genoveva warmed our hearts!
Our girl underwent iodine therapy, and his feedback on the treatment, hospitalization, and post-treatment was very kind and attentive!
May God greatly bless him!

The clinic of the "dad" of cats... Dr. Valdo. And the nickname is well-deserved. He is attentive, sensitive, humble, and during the consultation... he gives a lesson on the disease and treatment of your cat. Gratitude for all the care as always. Gratitude for being who you are 🙏

And Dr. Fernanda Coelho, today the "dad" of FELV cats... Wonderful, attentive, the consultation is a lesson. Spectacular! A professional who loves what she does 🥰 My children and I are very grateful to you ❤️
Nina 🐈🐈‍⬛ is 100% again thanks to the care of the whole team. 🖤 …
Excellent service! Excellent professionals, attentive and very caring with the kittens.

I want to express my immense gratitude to Vetmasters Clinic. Nina weighed just over 2 kilos due to hyperthyroidism. I researched treatment and found the clinic. We traveled from Campinas to São Paulo to undergo the treatment. Even before that, from our first contact with the clinic, we were very well attended to by the reception staff. Dr. Valdo also answered all my questions. On the scheduled day, we were seen by Dr. Gabriel, who reassured us about the procedure. When we picked up Nina, she had already gained weight. Yesterday we had the follow-up exams done and we are immensely happy to know that she is cured!!!! How wonderful that we found you! Congratulations on the clinic, the facilities, and the competence! Thanks to you, our Nina is cured!
Unique, very cool.

We met Dr. Fernanda through a recommendation from the Veterinary Hospital where our kitten Arthur was undergoing treatment. Unfortunately, he passed away due to the severity of his health condition, which progressed rapidly and devastatingly. Despite everything, we want to record and highlight the professionalism, competence, and above all, the respect and care we received from this dedicated, incredible, and wonderful professional!!
Having the opportunity to meet her at such a delicate moment gives us hope that professionals like Dr. Fernanda and many others are transforming Veterinary Medicine. And despite so many challenges, they are bringing new perspectives to treatment so that these little ones can have a better quality of life with their families.
My husband and I leave our affection, gratitude, and admiration for Dr. Fernanda for all the dedication in the short time we were together fighting for the life of our little Arthur. Congratulations and gratitude!!

I want to express my sincere gratitude to the team responsible for the iodine therapy procedure at the clinic! Especially the receptionists Vanessa and Delma, as well as Dr. Valdo, and particularly Dr. Gabriel! My daughter Nina is 14 years old and needed to repeat the procedure. I was very apprehensive and scared because we live in another city and I had already spent a lot on the first procedure. Dr. Gabriel was very empathetic and helped me a lot with my Nina, even spoiling her with treats! Gabriel was an angel in our lives! Thank you so much for everything! ❤️🐱🙏

I have no words for Dr. Fernanda.
There is no veterinarian like her or better! I can only thank her for everything! 🙏🏻 …

My 14-year-old cat, Fumaça, arrived at Vetmasters very weak, weighing only 1.5 kg due to hyperthyroidism. After iodine treatment, she began gaining weight within the first 3 days of hospitalization, and today she is fully recovered, without needing medication. The space is clean, welcoming, and designed for cats. The receptionists are cordial and quick in their service. I was closely monitored by Dr. Gabriel during the initial consultation and by Dr. Valdo, both by email and during the medical discharge consultation. Not to mention Jorge, the cat receptionist, who makes the environment even more welcoming. Gratitude for the care and professionalism, always with great technique, knowledge, and love. We need more professionals like this!

Pietra, my kitten, has been to many veterinarians, but none compare to the veterinarians at Master; they are the best, and I am grateful for their treatment and effort in seeing my kitten well ❤️❤️❤️, thank you.

The doctor was very attentive and knew how to help us with my dog's exam.
An ultrasound exam IN THE EYE!

Lol
Excellent service. Competent and caring veterinarians with our cats. Having a dedicated feline care area is a major plus.

Good place.

Excellent service.
I think I commented in the wrong clinic, my apologies everyone.
We give our little furry children all the care and affection they deserve.
Excellent service

I saw Mr. Mario Sano's unfounded criticism regarding iodine therapy, which, to my knowledge, Dr. Valdo (Archivaldo Reche Jr.) is a pioneer in and, I believe, the only one who provides a cure for hyperthyroidism in cats using this technique. My cat Kenny, who was already a patient at the clinic, underwent the procedure and IS CURED! He doesn't need any medication. He's chubby and no longer has hyperthyroidism. Mr. Mario Sano's criticism is completely unfounded because his cat was not a patient at the clinic and was not treated by the Vetmasters veterinarians. If she had been a patient, she would know the excellence of the professionals at that clinic. As a feline specialist in São Paulo, there is no other. I ask Mr. Mario Sano to get to know the clinic and the veterinarians there well and for a good amount of time before saying anything.

Veterinary clinic specializing in felines, with individual environments for each species, cat-friendly protocol, cordial service, air-conditioned environment, and safe, clean, and organized facilities. I am a cat sitter, and I accompanied my client's cat to an appointment with Dr. Carlos, a dermatologist, who provided excellent care, meticulous attention, and extreme professionalism. Thank you 🙏🏻

VetMasters has what I consider the most important thing: competent and attentive professionals. They could improve the infrastructure by completely separating the cat area, installing two doors (see 4cats) so we can let the cats out a bit without the risk of them escaping when someone enters or leaves, and improve the waiting area with comfortable and quiet chairs (because the current ones creak with every slight movement).

Dr. Valdo saved my cat Pietro. He was at another clinic that couldn't solve his problem. I took him to VetMaster, and Dr. Valdo was careful, assertive, and discussed and explained the treatment options if it wasn't possible to reverse the situation. Pietro was hospitalized for a day, had tests done, and at the time of discharge, Valdo prescribed medication that reversed the problem. He didn't need surgery, and he lived with me for 19 years. The cost I incurred with VetMaster was 1/3 of what I had already paid at another clinic that didn't solve the problem.

If any of my cats have a strange and difficult-to-diagnose condition, Valdo is the one I run to…
That's because I'm quite far from Pacaembú; if I were closer, only Valdo (Dr. Archivaldo Reche Júnior) would treat my children 😻. 1000 out of 10!!!

10 out of 10 for the clinic. Specialized care for cats.

I take all my cats to the clinic and have always received excellent service, not to mention that I have always felt very confident about the advice given there. The professionals' expertise is what sets them apart.

We had our cat Pretinho undergo iodine therapy three weeks ago and everything went very well. The doctors are very attentive and inspire confidence. The clinic only needs to hire more professionals to communicate with pet owners, because due to the high volume of patients, it is sometimes difficult to get information about the animal that is hospitalized.

Question the miracle of iodine therapy and the brilliant Dr. Valdo!!
I had a cat, Aysha Maria. She was 15 years and 11 months old when she underwent the procedure and died 22 hours after being discharged.

- In March 2024, she was diagnosed with hyperthyroidism and pleural effusion, which was analyzed and defined as chylothorax.

- Based on these two diagnoses, she began being monitored by a pulmonologist and an endocrinologist. The one who monitored Aysha was Dr. Anna Maria Schnabel, who repeatedly recommended iodine therapy with Dr. Valdo, stating that the risk was 0.
- We contacted Dr. Valdo by email, sent all the requested exams, and informed him of the diagnoses, treatments, and all the medication she was taking. Dr. Valdo himself stated that there would be no objection regarding her clinical condition. - The iodine therapy procedure was scheduled for February 10, 2025, and we, her guardians, as a precaution, consulted a pulmonologist on February 1, 2025, to determine if she was fit for it. It was confirmed that she was fit and in a normal state of life. This means she had a normal life.

- On February 10, 2025, we took her to Dr. Gabriel at VetMasters for a clinical examination before the iodine therapy. An analysis was performed, and it was decided to drain a small portion of the chylothorax to proceed with the iodine therapy procedure. During this pre-procedure consultation, we were again questioned about the risks, and once again, we were told that there were no risks, that it was a very straightforward process, and that the biggest obstacle would be isolation. Aysha was then placed there for the procedure.

- We contacted them every day, and all we were told was that everything was fine, everything was normal.

- On February 12, 2025, at the time of discharge, at 12:00 PM, Aysha was sitting with her mouth slightly open. As her guardian, I assumed it was due to stress and brought her home to Mogi das Cruzes. After a journey of about 90 minutes, the kitten arrived staggering and having considerable difficulty breathing. We contacted Dr. Gabriel, who took more than 50 minutes to get back to us and was still saying that in 2 days she had developed enough chylothorax to affect her breathing so much. I doubted him, but I followed his instructions to take her to an emergency hospital. This was around 2:00 PM.

- At the hospital, an ultrasound was requested to check the extent of the chylothorax, which quickly ruled out that as the cause of the difficulty. Apparently, she was stabilized and returned home (a 20-minute journey), and when she arrived, she was in the same condition as when she was admitted to the hospital. We returned immediately.
- From that moment on, Dr. Valdo returned to the story, claiming it could be thyrotoxicosis, meaning we lost at least 4 hours investigating something that could have been reported from the start. From that point on, the true Dr. Valdo and the miracle of iodine therapy are revealed.

- At that moment, he said the cat needed to be hospitalized, put on oxygen, and take medication for thyrotoxicosis.

- My cat was taken to a semi-ICU to receive Butorphanol and to have a feeding tube inserted to send oxygen directly to her lungs.

- With no improvement in Aysha's condition, it was necessary to move her to an ICU, this was around 9:00 PM on February 12th.

- In the ICU, she was intubated and passed away at 10:00 AM on February 13th, 2025.

- Dr. Valdo called me around noon that day, already aware of Aysha's death, to "talk." He said that, in fact, being an elderly cat with chylothorax, there would be a certain risk in the procedure. When questioned why he didn't mention this during the entire admission process and even during Dr. Gabriel's evaluation, he said that the procedure form I signed at the time of the iodine therapy should have stipulated that severe thyrotoxicosis could lead to death. He started saying that it was the only option for Aysha, that she had no quality of life, even though he had never seen her, never had a consultation with her, and in his mind, he believed that refunding the cost of the procedure would undo the harm he did to Aysha.
Excellent service!
Thank you for your feedback, and we are very happy to have met your expectations.
Excellent multidisciplinary team. Everyone was very attentive and committed. Congratulations!

Our Amora, whom we adopted from someone who rescued her from a cat colony here in Campinas, and who had to have one of her eyes removed, was taken to several clinics here in Campinas, but there was no solution to eliminate this bacteria, only tests and more tests, and nothing.
We managed to get her seen at Vetmaster by Dr. Valdo, and in his absence, by Dr. Fernanda, always being received by Dr. Gabriel.
We received first-rate care, and most importantly, the bacteria was eliminated.
I want to record here that Dr. Valdo, even at conferences, never failed to respond to me, even immediately.
We want to record the care with which Amora was treated and recovered; in her case, we will have to monitor her indefinitely according to Dr. Valdo's instructions.
And today we will be taking our Miguel for the first time, who was rescued after being hit by a car or a stick, which also caused him to lose an eye.
Not forgetting to thank the entire frontline team for the wonderful reception we have always received.
